question: Direction of the magnetic field produced by the straight conductor carrying current in the east direction is along the _____ direction
solution:
The correct answer is** 'South'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Right-hand rule** says -the magnetic field made by **a current in straight conductor** curls around the conductor in a ring. You can find it by pointing your** right thumb** in the direction of the conducting straight wire and curling your fingers. Your fingers will be curled in the same direction as the magnetic field around the conductor.
 
• Direction of the **magnetic field** produced by the straight conductor carrying current in the east direction is along the South__ direction
